newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Kirch group to be turned into foundation.
newsitem.headline: German Kirch group to be turned into foundation.

text.p: German media mogul Leo Kirch will turn his group into a foundation, formalising the group's holding function, the Kirch group said at the weekend.
The Kirch foundation will begin operations next year.
Leo Kirch, celebrating his 70th birthday on Monday, will initially be the sole manager but appoint others including five supervisory board members.
Kirch's son Thomas will be appointed to a key position in the holding group, the group said.
